title: Kansallinen syöpästrategia 2026–2035 – Toimeenpanon tiekartta vuosille 2026–2031
titleEn: Finland's National Cancer Strategy 2026–2035: Roadmap for implementation for 2026–2031

text.pageSeparator: form feed (U+000C); page N of the PDF is the text before the N-th form feed
text.pageNumbering: The printed page number equals the PDF page number. Checked on every page: the last text line is the page number except on pages 1, 5, 105, 108 and 111 (cover, contents, cost tables, colophon).

quoteRule: Every Finnish quote in mapping-v1.json is a verbatim substring of the stated page of roadmap.txt after removing soft hyphens (U+00AD) and collapsing each run of whitespace to one space. tests/roadmap.test.mjs checks this. Footnote numbers that pdftotext glues to words are left out of quotes by quoting around them.
